# Genesis Apocryphon Column 22 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 22 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 22:1 — "set before her" / "assigned to Sarai as her personal servant"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "set before-her Hagar as-a-handmaid" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "set before her Hagar as a handmaid" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "assigned Hagar to Sarai as her personal servant" | Dynamic; modernizes |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. PNEUMA's "personal servant" anachronistically modernizes the institution. "Handmaid" is the established term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 22:5 — "went out with very great flocks" / "departed a wealthy man"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "went-out with-very-great-flocks" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "went out with very great flocks" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "departed a wealthy man, with enormous flocks" | Dynamic; interprets |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. PNEUMA's "a wealthy man" adds a characterization not in the text; the wealth is shown, not stated.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 22:8 — "taken for himself a wife" / "married a woman"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "had-taken for-himself a-wife from-among-the-daughters of-Egypt" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "had taken for himself a wife from among the daughters of Egypt" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "had married a woman from among the Egyptian women" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. "Taken a wife from among the daughters of" is the established biblical idiom and should be preserved.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 22:18 — "branches of the River" / "tributaries of the Nile"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-branches of-the-River" | Literal; "River" capitalized for the Nile |
| LOGOS | "the branches of the River" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "the tributaries of the Nile" | Dynamic; identifies the river |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Compromise: "the tributaries of the Nile." The identification is certain, and "tributaries" is more geographically precise than "branches" for river channels.

**Status:** Resolved as compromise (PNEUMA's identification, LOGOS's structure).

---

## 22:25 — "seed" / "descendants"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "your-seed" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "your seed" | Formal; traditional biblical term |
| PNEUMA | "your descendants" | Dynamic; modern English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "descendants" for consistency with Column 19 consensus.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of PNEUMA (for consistency).

---

## 22:27 — "shall be counted" / "could be counted"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shall-be-counted" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "shall be counted" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "could your descendants be counted" | Dynamic; conditional |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "shall be counted." The "shall" maintains the divine speech register.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 22:28 — "Arise" / "Get up"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Rise-up" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "Arise" | Formal; traditional |
| PNEUMA | "Get up" | Dynamic; colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "Arise" — consistent with 19:10 and appropriate for divine commands.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 22:29 — "went traveling" / "set out on a journey to explore"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "went traveling to-go-about" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "went traveling, going about" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "set out on a journey to explore" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. PNEUMA's "explore" adds a connotation of discovery not in the Aramaic; Abram is surveying what is already promised.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 8*
*Resolution: LOGOS 6, PNEUMA 1, Compromise 1, EMET 0*
